automatic.check: Shell, Incident Detail, Home, Analyze, Incidents, History, System/Inventory, Diagnostic Readiness, Settings and Export/Support and Capture each have one production AXAML implementation; confirmation dialogs and the missing-incident fallback are also AXAML

CaptureView, CaptureRestoreCard and CaptureConfirmationWindow own layout inside the existing System host; MainWindow.Capture.cs only forwards explicit actions. Workflow, privilege, journal, reread, drift and newer-action behavior are unchanged

Capture reads purpose/current state/target/fixed policy/open consent/read-only preview/Configure/result/recovery/journal/technical details. All existing safety prose remains open before Configure; the fixed policy has no editable options; target changes invalidate Preview through the existing workflow. Content reuses the 800 epx form measure and stacks at compact widths

Result styling projects existing outcome codes; verified success keeps the existing Success plus observed-state predicate. Cancellation and Pending never use verified styling. Recorded absence has an explicit previous-state summary; actual previous values and raw previous/requested/observed details remain available. Restore candidate wording retains safety checks; drift and newer-action refusals stay adjacent without changing eligibility or helper executions

Capture has one visible Polite owner: preview notice before a result, operation text while busy, latest result after settlement. Verification, Restore guard and historical journal text do not announce duplicates. Target/Preview/Refresh/architecture/Configure/Restore/disclosures retain keyboard order and focus across locale/theme/navigation updates; presentation causes no helper execution

Diagnostic Readiness preserves each localized capability state and explanation as text, keeps technical observations disclosed, does not score system health and never requests elevation automatically; analysis coverage retains its separate Complete/Partial/Unavailable/AccessDenied/NotSupported states
Settings and Export/Support retain control instances and selection through all eight runtime locales and System/Light/Dark theme changes; export preview uses the existing redacted formatter and bound
Recent, around-time and import modes have distinct guidance; empty readiness gives a relevant next step; capture technical values are collapsed and Configure keeps its existing guards

Home and period-based Analyze explain supported-record scope; quiet results distinguish zero incidents, Background-only context and filter-hidden results, while preserving Complete, Partial, Unavailable, AccessDenied and NotSupported coverage states
Shared actions retain keyboard focus and disabled invocation guards in Light/Dark; primary default, hover and pressed text contrast is at least 4.5:1

Incidents filter fields use one, two or three aligned columns based on actual available page content width; Search stretches independently of placeholder length and query/filter state survives resize and runtime locale/theme updates
Analysis and Privacy selector fields share the left inset of General while retaining existing values, persistence and runtime updates
All stored severity enum values use localized History display labels in all eight locales; persistence and export values remain unchanged
Native Avalonia DatePicker presentation follows Windows regional culture; switching FaultWitness language changes app-owned copy but leaves selected DateTime values and query intervals unchanged
Analyze form content is left-aligned and capped at 800 epx on wide pages, while compact layouts use available content width
Token document contains typed values and valid references
Token alias graph is acyclic
Light and Dark semantic color sets match
normal text >=4.5:1; status/icon colors >=3:1 where used
All required semantic components and structured fields exist
Every declared command area has at most one PrimaryAction
Design specs and user-facing resources contain no health-score feature
All language keys and placeholders match English
No raw color literals outside token source and documented platform exceptions
Incident detail raw data disclosure is collapsed initially
Top-level navigation matches Home, Analyze, Incidents, History, System; Settings is separated
Every screen declares a keyboard flow and default focus
Brand has one text line at 639/640/641 epx in all supported languages
Current destination has selection class, visible shape, emphasized label and accessible state; Detail maps to Incidents and Readiness to System

Three accessible count actions use three intrinsic columns only when all labels fit actual Home content width; otherwise they form one full-width column with canonical 4 epx spacing and no 2+1 orphan row at 600/640/641
History keeps a 16 epx canonical gap after its heading and between compact list/detail regions; large 40/60 layout, empty-state meaning, scan selection and independent detail scroll remain intact

Scoped lists use AppSurface ordinary rows, AppSurfaceMuted hover, AppSelection selected, visible focus and muted disabled text; semantic disclosures use AppSurfaceMuted headers, AppSurface bodies, AppBorder divisions and preserve Fluent expansion/chevrons in Light and Dark
Missing-incident fallback remains the existing localized explanation, sizes to content and aligns at the top at compact and desktop widths
Ready is hidden; settled feedback clears on navigation; active operations stay accessible in the shell away from their originating page/mode; shell shares PageHost measure on wide windows

Analyze validation and running/cancellation text precede the existing Analyze/Cancel command area; Export feedback precedes Copy/Save; HistoryError appears near its heading with existing Refresh history. All project the single MainViewModel status without changing validation, calls, output or result classification

Exactly one visible Polite live owner per status: local on its owning page/mode, otherwise shell. Input edits expire validation without revalidating; new commands replace settled feedback/detail; delayed Copy/Save outcomes retain origin and cannot replace a newer command. Feedback updates preserve focus and expose validation as input HelpText

Existing load/update HistoryError and loading suppress the known-empty claim; successful empty loads show it, successful populated loads retain selection, and failed refreshes preserve prior rows. No persistence/query/retention change
Incident detail support preview/copy remains discoverable without PrimaryAction
Selected row uses semantic selection surface and visible indicator; scan identity, keyboard focus and selection survive runtime language/theme updates without render re-entry

All migrated AXAML pages retain their views and accessible control names during runtime EN/IT/ES/FR/DE/PT/RU/PL and System/Light/Dark changes; Analyze inputs, incident filters, History selection, System subpage, Settings selections, Export options and Capture target/architecture/outer disclosure remain stateful
Observed fact, existing best next step, every distinct interpretation and causal limitation appear in reading order without opening technical disclosures; optional empty sections are omitted

Existing incident identity, action order, all evidence including duplicates and late limiting Unknown items, timeline relations, coverage states, change relevance and occurrence data are retained without independent scoring

All eight languages switch while detail is open; Light/Dark/System, widths 560/600/640/641/1008/1280/1920 and navigation preserve selection, cached view and outer disclosure state; commands remain named and keyboard operable

semiAutomatic.check: In the established disposable environment only, validate explicit Preview/UAC approval/Configure/reread/journal/Restore/exact previous state, UAC cancellation and a safe drift refusal. Synthetic UI/security tests do not establish this gate.
Headless layouts at 560, 600, 640, 641, 1008, 1280, and 1920 effective pixels show no page-level horizontal overflow or navigation overlap
Virtualized incident list handles 100, 1000, and 5000 incidents without materializing a huge visual tree
Primary actions, navigation, list rows, disclosures, and destructive controls are keyboard focusable and named
All supported languages instantiate main screens at compact and large widths
Earlier databases migrate without losing retained summaries

Preview is neutral, verified success restrained, cancellation distinct from failure and historical Pending visibly unverified. Previous-state summaries and refusal reasons stay near Restore; technical disclosures start closed; safety information remains complete and open in long compact locales
All AXAML pages, including Capture embedded inside System, retain readable hierarchy and actions at compact and desktop sizes in Light and Dark

System inventory values wrap safely; Readiness keeps Complete/Partial/Unavailable/AccessDenied/NotSupported distinctions readable without color; Settings and Export controls remain usable in long locales
Scope copy remains subordinate; quiet complete and limited-coverage results remain distinct; filter-empty state offers Reset filters only when records are hidden
Incident Detail first viewport or short scroll answers what happened, what to do, what evidence suggests and what cannot be concluded before technical expansion
Incident Detail uses one strongest next-step surface, distinct assessment/limits, open grouped evidence and subordinate closed investigation details
